meta.title: About Sabano | Non-governmental research and technology fund
meta.description: Sabano is a non-governmental research and technology fund focused on the digital economy. Learn about its mission, capital horizon, values and shareholders.

hero.title: Capital for innovation and growth
hero.lead: Sabano Non-Governmental Research and Technology Fund is a financial institution focused on the digital economy. It works alongside technology companies and innovative businesses to make financial tools and investment easier to access. Its principal shareholder is Saba Mihan Holding and it is headquartered in Tehran.

what.title: What does Sabano do?
what.text: Through guarantees, credit services, investment in technology ventures, financial agency and financial advisory, Sabano smooths the growth path of technology companies and helps connect them with larger markets. With a forward-looking approach, it also follows opportunities in artificial intelligence and financial technology.

mission.title: Mission and approach
mission.text: With a focus on the digital economy, Sabano helps technology companies grow and helps create sustainable growth opportunities. Each service is provided according to the assessment of the project and the applicable rules.

horizon.title: Development horizon
horizon.label: Target capital by March 2027
horizon.text: Sabano’s development horizon is to grow its capital to 1,000 billion tomans by the end of the Iranian year 1405 (March 2027) and to play a leading role in the country’s knowledge-based sector. The target will be refined as the fund’s strategy documents are completed.

items.title: Focus on the digital economy
items.text: Artificial intelligence, fintech, digital infrastructure and future-shaping technologies are at the heart of Sabano’s work.

items.title: Support for technology companies
items.text: The fund’s financial tools are designed around the real needs of technology businesses.

items.title: Long-term value creation
items.text: Sabano thinks in terms of sustainable growth rather than short-term returns, for companies and for the wider economy.

shareholders.title: Who are Sabano’s shareholders?
shareholders.text: Sabano’s principal shareholder is Saba Mihan Holding. Jabiz Technology Development Company, Yas Innovation Center and Ala Tejarat Fanavari are also shareholders of the fund.

guarantee.title: Guarantees
guarantee.short: Guarantees to support eligible activities of technology companies and projects.
guarantee.metaDescription: Sabano issues guarantees for eligible activities of technology companies and projects. Learn how guarantees help, what to prepare and how to apply.
guarantee.lead: Sabano issues guarantees to support eligible activities of technology companies and projects. A guarantee lets a technology company take part in tenders and contracts without tying up its own cash. The type and terms of each guarantee are set after reviewing the request and according to the fund’s rules.
whoFor: Technology and knowledge-based companies bidding for tenders or contracts
Technology projects that need backing for their commitments
Businesses active in the digital economy
benefits: Keep your cash for product and team development
Take part in larger projects and contracts
An assessment that understands technology businesses
documents: An introduction to the company and its technology
The related contract or tender documents
Financial information and delivery track record
The amount and term of the guarantee you need

faqs.q: What kinds of guarantees does Sabano issue?
faqs.a: The type of guarantee depends on the applicant’s needs and the fund’s rules. Research and technology funds typically issue guarantees such as bid bonds, performance bonds and advance-payment guarantees. Submit a request to find out whether the guarantee you need can be issued.

faqs.q: Can any company get a guarantee?
faqs.a: Guarantees are issued for eligible activities after the request has been reviewed. The exact criteria are assessed under the fund’s rules.
Submit your request through the cooperation form, choose “Financing” as the request type and attach documents such as the contract or tender papers.

credit.title: Credit and financing
credit.short: Review of financing options and credit services suited to the applicant’s needs.
credit.metaTitle: Credit and financing for technology companies | Sabano
credit.metaDescription: Sabano reviews financing and credit options matched to the needs of technology companies. See what to prepare and how to apply.
credit.lead: Sabano reviews financing and credit services matched to each applicant’s needs and situation. The service is for technology companies that need funds to deliver a contract, develop a product or cover working capital. The terms of any facility are set after the project has been assessed.
whoFor: Technology companies that need funds to deliver a contract
Businesses that need capital for product or market development
Projects with clear and predictable revenue
benefits: A review of your funding need by people who understand technology businesses
A service shaped around your situation
Access to the fund’s other services where needed
documents: An introduction to the company and team
Your funding need and how the funds will be used
Financial statements or a performance report

faqs.q: How are Sabano’s financing terms set?
faqs.a: The terms of each facility are set after reviewing the project and according to the fund’s rules. Submit a request to learn which terms fit your needs.

faqs.q: What can financing be used for?
faqs.a: For funding needs linked to technology activities, such as delivering a contract, developing a product or covering working capital. Whether financing is possible is decided after review.
A company introduction, a description of your funding need, financial information and related contracts help speed up the review. Further documents are requested if needed.

investment.title: Investment in technology ventures
investment.short: Assessment of innovative opportunities and potential participation in business growth.
investment.metaTitle: Investment in technology ventures and startups | Sabano
investment.metaDescription: Sabano assesses innovative opportunities in the digital economy and takes part in the growth of promising businesses. See the assessment criteria and what to prepare.
investment.lead: Sabano assesses innovative opportunities and, where they fit the fund’s strategy, takes part in the growth of the business. Sabano invests with a focus on the digital economy, from artificial intelligence and fintech to digital infrastructure and future-shaping technologies.
whoFor: Startups and technology companies in the digital economy
Teams with a clear product or solution to a real problem
Businesses with the potential to grow into larger markets
benefits: A financial partner with a long-term view
Deep understanding of the digital economy and fintech
Support on the path to growth and larger markets
documents: An introduction to the team and relevant experience
Current status, traction and financial plan

faqs.q: Which sectors does Sabano invest in?
faqs.a: Sabano focuses on the digital economy: artificial intelligence and data-driven solutions, fintech and modern financial services, digital infrastructure and services, and future-shaping technologies.
The problem and solution, target market, business model, team capability and fit with Sabano’s investment focus are among the most important factors.

faqs.q: Does submitting a proposal mean Sabano will invest?
faqs.a: No. Receiving a proposal is not approval or a commitment to invest, and every proposal is assessed under the fund’s rules.

fund-agency.lead: As a financial agent, Sabano manages and allocates funds under approved agreements and programmes. The service helps institutions and organisations that want to channel their funds to technology projects and companies through a specialised financial institution.
whoFor: Institutions and organisations with funds to support innovation
Support programmes that need specialised fund management
Organisations that want to back technology companies financially
benefits: Funds managed under an approved agreement and programme
Allocation of funds to eligible projects
documents: An introduction to your institution and programme
The size and purpose of the funds
The criteria you want projects to meet

faqs.a: In financial agency, a specialised institution such as Sabano manages an organisation’s or programme’s funds under an approved agreement and allocates them to eligible projects and companies.

faqs.q: Which institutions can use this service?
faqs.a: Institutions and organisations that have funds for technology activities and want them allocated under an approved agreement. Whether a partnership is possible is decided after review.
In the cooperation form, choose “Strategic partnership” and briefly describe the programme and funds you have in mind.

hero.title: Working with Sabano, step by step
hero.lead: Working with Sabano starts with a request through the online form. Your request receives an initial review, further information is gathered if needed, and the project is then assessed under the fund’s rules before a decision is shared. This guide explains each step and what to prepare.

process.stepsTitle: What are the steps to work with Sabano?

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Get your project summary, team introduction and supporting documents ready. The more precise the information, the faster the review.

steps.title: Submit
steps.text: Fill in the cooperation form, choose a request type and attach a supporting file. You receive a tracking code once it is submitted.

steps.title: Initial review
steps.text: The request is checked for fit with Sabano’s services and focus areas, and further information is requested if needed.

steps.title: Expert assessment
steps.text: Projects that fit the fund’s strategy are assessed under its rules, looking at technical, market, financial and team aspects.

steps.title: Decision
steps.text: You are informed of the outcome and, if approved, of the terms and next steps.

process.note: Exact steps and timing vary with the type of request and service.

prepare.title: What should I prepare before submitting?
items: A one- or two-paragraph project summary
An introduction to the team and relevant experience
Current status of the product or service and traction
Funding need and how the funds will be used
A supporting file (preferably PDF, up to 8 MB)

timing.title: How long does a review take?
timing.text: Review time depends on the type of request, how complete the information is and how complex the project is. Sending accurate and complete information from the start is the single biggest factor in shortening it.

mistakes.title: Common mistakes when submitting a proposal
items: Long, general descriptions that never state the core problem
No information about the team and each member’s role
An unclear funding need or use of funds
Contact details that are not checked regularly

meta.title: Sabano privacy policy
meta.description: Which information Sabano receives through this website’s forms, why, how it is stored and what rights you have.

hero.title: Privacy policy
hero.lead: Sabano only collects the information needed to review and respond to your request. This page explains what is collected, how it is used and how it is stored.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.text: When you submit the cooperation form, we store your name, contact details, company and website (if provided), your message and any attachment. To prevent abuse, a one-way hash of your IP address and your browser type are also recorded.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.text: Your information is used only to review your request, contact you about it and prevent malicious submissions. It is not shared with third parties for advertising.

sections.title: How it is stored
sections.text: Requests and attachments are stored on the fund’s servers and only authorised staff can access them. Attachments are never publicly available through the website.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.text: This website does not use advertising or tracking cookies. Only strictly necessary cookies are used for staff sign-in to the admin panel.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You can email {email} to ask for a copy of the information you sent or for it to be deleted, unless the law requires us to keep it.
